newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares hold strong gains.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares hold strong gains.

text.p: U.S. stocks held fast to strong gains in afternoon trade on Wednesday, taking heart from a robust bond market, a benign inflation outlook and positive sentiment surrounding the balanced budget pact.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up 55 points or 0.67 percent at 8229, after pushing to record levels around midday.
The Nasdaq composite gained 14 points at 1586.
The long bond extended its up 26/32 to yield 6.36 percent.
